spi_hz.doc: Requested mode-0 host SCLK; must not exceed supplied axpe clock/4.

sck_gpio.doc: Pico SPI0 clock GPIO (2, 6, 18 or 22); rewire the loader when changed.

mosi_gpio.doc: Pico SPI0 TX GPIO (3, 7 or 19); GPIO23 is reserved on Pico 2.

cs_gpio.doc: Pico output GPIO for active-low loader select.

ena_gpio.doc: Pico output GPIO for axpe design selection.

reset_gpio.doc: Pico output GPIO for active-low board reset.

capture_gpio.doc: Pico PWM output to FPGA capture_clk; normal mode holds it low.

reset_delay_us.doc: Positive reset assertion duration; release delay is at least this and the resolved FPGA reset-counter duration.

cs_delay_us.doc: Positive delay before and after each selected host frame.

poll_timeout_ms.doc: Positive deadline for a runtime program to reach HALT.

serial_timeout_ms.doc: Positive deadline for each USB-line response. USB line baud is a transport convention, independent of SPI and UART workload rates.
